parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the cabinet made of laminated particle board, rectangular in shape and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened and protects contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the cabinet made of laminated particle board, rectangular in shape and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and closes to conceal stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board, forming the outer box and supporting the doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Bottom Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board, rectangular and horizontally placed.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet’s interior space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Middle Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board, rectangular and horizontally placed.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items and divides the cabinet vertically.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Top Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board, rectangular and horizontally placed.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and forms the upper section of the cabinet’s interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
